requirements.title: MODULO integer result satisfies quotient and sign inequalities
requirements.definition: For integer operands, MODULO(A,P) has value R such that A equals Q times P plus R for an integer Q, with 0 <= R < P for positive P and P < R <= 0 for negative P.

pending.MODULO-integer-positive-P-nonnegative-re: Use MODULO(8,5) expecting exact integer 3 and MODULO(-8,5) expecting exact integer 2; mutate to MOD so the negative-A case fails.
pending.MODULO-integer-negative-A-positive-P: Use MODULO(-8,5) expecting exact integer 2, proving the result range follows positive P rather than A sign.
pending.MODULO-integer-positive-A-negative-P: Use MODULO(8,-5) expecting exact integer -2, paired with MODULO(8,5) so P sign is load-bearing.
pending.MODULO-integer-negative-P-result-range: Use MODULO(-8,-5) expecting exact integer -3, proving the negative-P range P < R <= 0.

requirements.title: MODULO real result value has approximation latitude
requirements.definition: For real operands, MODULO is defined by A minus FLOOR(A/P) times P, but exact rounded real results are processor approximations rather than portable conformance oracles.

pending.MODULO-real-result-approximation-latitud: No portable exact-value oracle: real division, FLOOR conversion, multiplication, and subtraction can introduce processor approximation. Future fixtures may check type and kind plus separately justified bounded properties, never a required rounded real value.
